title: Hexsweeper 3D — Moon Ink Orrery
tagline: Hex minesweeper on a Goldberg sphere, restyled as an ink-brushed lunar orrery where height becomes moonlight.
aesthetic: A cool paper-moon observatory: deep indigo field, pale shell tiles like unbroken rice paper, cleared wells as brushed ink pools. The sphere floats with a soft offset shadow and turns slowly on its own, more planetarium instrument than puzzle grid.
mechanicTwist: Ink-depth tinting: cleared numbered wells darken and their ring-strokes thicken with count value (1 = faint single brush ring, 6 = dense saturated ring), so the danger gradient reads as calligraphy weight, not color noise. Flags glow a soft vermillion halo, and a gentle auto-spin pauses while the pointer is over the board.
helpLede: Left-tap digs a paper face; right-tap plants a vermillion flag. The first dig is always safe — read the brush rings to count the six neighbors.
hudNote: The moon turns while you think. Flags left: N.
